risks: PCBoxRenderWork is a very large struct (>0x88E0) allocated in a SIBLING ov14 chunk (via ov14_021EAF8C path); every function here dereferences app->work at 0x34. Field types (many ldrb/ldrh/ldr at fixed offsets) must be pinned exactly before decompiling this chunk - get the work struct definition from the allocating chunk first.

Rodata ordering is load-bearing: 7 BgTemplates + GraphicsModes(ov14_021F7BC8) + GraphicsBanks(ov14_021F7CE4) must emit in exact declaration order; note BgTemplate use order in ov14_021E5A70 is NOT address order (C58 used for bg4 comes after C90).
ov14_021E5A70 InitBgFromTemplate loop needs 7 SEPARATE stack BgTemplate locals (frame 0xd4), per insight bg-init-separate-template-locals; a single reused local collapses the frame and mismatches.
Signed-division idioms: _s32_div_f (ov14_021E6464 /6, ov14_021E7278 /0x1e) and the round-toward-zero /8 idiom (asr;lsr#0x1d;add;asr#3) in ov14_021E6B48/6C0C must be matched carefully.
Fixed-point sprite-position math (mul then lsr#0x10) in ov14_021E65C4/66F4/6814 - FX16/FX32 scaling; register scheduling sensitive.
Bitfield extracts in ov14_021E5F4C / ov14_021E5EFC on packed cursor-anim struct at work+0x88D4 - model as bitfields/union.

Several large state machines not analyzed in detail (ov14_021E8D20, 8FD4, 96C8, 9A24, 9C88, A254, A4C8, A778, ACD4) - likely switch/jump-table lowering; expect objdiff SIZE false-positives on jump tables, gate on chiri pkg compare.

0x1e (30) is the pervasive party/box slot boundary and 0x80 is a party-flag bit throughout the move logic (ov14_021E6CF8/6F3C/7034/690C): slot>=0x1e => party slot (slot-0x1e), high bit 0x80 => party-origin marker.
notes: Chunk 1 of the 11-way split of overlay_14 (PC Box storage UI). Export/import split: the .inc .public block (lines 188-347) lists the NON-STATIC functions defined in this chunk; every thumb_func_start in the .s NOT in that subset is a static/local helper. All functions are Thumb. ov14_* symbols in .public NOT defined here are imports from sibling chunks. Deep-analyzed the entry callbacks + box/party mon accessor family (021E6070/6094/60C0/6100/6464/6480/64D0) at high confidence; the ~140 remaining drawing/state/move helpers share PCBoxAppData(0x38) + PCBoxRenderWork(0x34) and were surveyed at signature level. Lower confidence on move/swap ops (021E611C-021E7034) and the large state machines.
